title: Caching & Batching — Coordinate a Shared Cache Safely
key_insight: Request coalescing lets one worker refresh while others wait or receive a stale-safe value. Randomized expiry prevents many keys expiring together.
body:
## Coordinate a Shared Cache Safely

A popular key expires and thousands of requests recompute it at once. The cache miss becomes an outage.

Request coalescing lets one worker refresh while others wait or receive a stale-safe value. Randomized expiry prevents many keys expiring together.

Measure hit rate, saved cost, added lookup time, and stale-error rate. A high hit rate is harmful if the reused answers are no longer correct.
common_mistakes: One global cache key is safe for private users.
A high cache hit rate proves answers are fresh.
mini_exercise: Draw “Coordinate a Shared Cache Safely” as three steps and explain each one.
real_world_usage: Caching avoids repeated work and batching shares hardware work, but both require correctness and freshness rules.
explain_back_prompt: Use “Coordinate a Shared Cache Safely” to explain Caching & Batching plainly.
